translations.english: Foregoing the beneficial, meaningful, and gentle words of counsel of significance in the past, present and future also (given by Vibheeshana), Ravana seized with anger replied in this manner.
translations.hindi: बिभीषण के ।हतकर, अर्थयुक्त, सदु; युक्तियुक्तं और तीनों कालो में लाभप्रद वचन सुनकर,रावण बहुत क्रु हा, बोला
